theater: 瀘南晏州與思峨洞山區

battle.name: 晏州之戰
battle.theater: 瀘南晏州與思峨洞山區
battle.brief: 政和五年正月，瀘南晏州大首領卜漏起兵，眾十餘萬攻圍樂共、長寧等寨堡，終奇襲攻陷梅嶺堡。宋以梓州路轉運使趙遹為瀘南招討統制使，調涇原、環慶、永興兵與土軍、義軍、保甲弓手，共三萬五百四十人，十月自江安分三路攻輪縛大囤。官軍強弓弩仰射不能及半，趙遹乃遣兵攀崖燃炬破寨，擒卜漏，瀘南悉平。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 晏州之戰的交戰雙方，是北宋朝廷與瀘南晏州一帶的諸部族聯盟。叛方並非一個政權，而是以晏州多岡部大首領卜漏為盟主的鬆散聯盟：政和五年正月起事時，他能號召晏州六縣水路十二村、思峨州洞眾、瀘南十州五村團熟夷，以及羅始黨百三十餘村寨，合稱十餘萬眾；九月朝廷詔書則判斷其所部不滿萬兵，前者是可驅使的人口，後者才是能戰之兵。部族間無常設君長，首領多稱都老，遇事鳴銅鼓集合，各村自守自屯，遇官軍則合散自如。北宋一方則是標準的路分調兵格局：主事者為梓州路轉運使趙遹，提點刑獄賈若水與梓州路走馬承受丁升卿參贊文案；地方官員有瀘州知州賈宗諒（事後以康師魯代）、長寧軍知軍劉堯年、瀘州都巡檢使種友直、思黔州巡檢田祐恭，兵馬監押潘虎領樂共城防務。七月朝廷命趙遹為瀘南招討統制使，王育、馬覺為同統制，雷迪、丁升卿為軍前承受，孫羲叟、王良弼應副錢糧，各部均聽趙遹節制；陝西涇原、環慶、永興、秦鳳各路兵馬由各路帥臣選將，每千人作一番，限五日起發，押赴瀘南聽用。十月出師，除陝西將兵外，本路尚有土軍、義軍、土丁子弟、保甲弓手與人夫隨行，遠射兵力主要靠保甲弓手與土丁補足。
countriesEn: The two sides in the battle of Yanzhou were the court of the Northern Song and a confederation of the tribal communities of southern Luzhou around Yanzhou. The insurgents were not a state but a loose league held together by Bu Lou, the great chief of the Duogang branch of Yanzhou: when he rose in the first month of Zhenghe 5 (1115) he could call on the twelve river villages of Yanzhou's six counties, the people of the Si'e caves, the settled natives of the five village-groups of the ten districts to the south, and more than a hundred and thirty villages of the Luo Shidang clan, a following put at over a hundred thousand; the rescript of the ninth month, by contrast, judged that the armed force of the insurgents numbered fewer than ten thousand. The first figure counts the population he could summon, the second counts the men who could fight. The communities had no standing ruler: their chiefs were called dulao, they were summoned by the beating of a bronze drum, each village garrisoned and provisioned itself, and they massed and dispersed as they pleased before a government army. On the Song side the pattern was the standard one of a circuit official conducting a war with troops drawn from other circuits. The man in charge was Zhao Yi, transport commissioner of the Zizhou circuit, with Jia Ruoshui, commissioner of the judicial circuit, and Ding Shengqing, the circuit's walking emissary, assisting with the paperwork. The local officers were Jia Zongliang, governor of Luzhou, who was later replaced by Kang Shilu; Liu Yaonian, administrator of Changning; Zhong Youzhi, patrol commander of Luzhou; Tian Yougong, patrol commander of Siqian; and Pan Hu, the mounted commander who held the defence of Yuegong city. In the seventh month the court appointed Zhao Yi commander of the southern Luzhou punitive expedition, with Wang Yu and Ma Jue as co-commanders, Lei Di and Ding Shengqing as army envoys, and Sun Xisou and Wang Liangbi in charge of money and provisions, all of them answering to Zhao Yi. The troops came from the Jingyuan, Huanqing, Yongxing and Qinfeng circuits of Shaanxi, each circuit choosing its own officers, each thousand men travelling as a separate body under a commander, ordered to start within five days and to place themselves at Zhao Yi's disposal in southern Luzhou. When the expedition set out in the tenth month it carried, besides the Shaanxi contingents, the local trained companies, volunteer levies, the sons of the tribal levies, the bowmen of the baojia militia and a great number of porters, so that the shooting strength of the force was supplied largely by the militia bowmen and the tribal levies.
people: 主導此役的是梓州路轉運使趙遹。他巡察至昌州時聽見警報，馳至瀘州，與賈若水議定萬一賊乘勢長驅逾瀘水該如何抵禦，遂急督賈宗諒屯兵江安縣，據水當賊衝，以近邊諸壘轉餉給軍；其後密奏瀘帥激變之罪，自請專行招安，兵端既開，又請調陝西之兵。他探明輪縛大囤有一處崖壁陡絕而守備疏缺，微服躍馬按視全軍，定下以火破寨之計，十一月破囤擒卜漏，拓地二千餘里，建寨堡、募民耕種、使民習戰守如西北弓箭社，出師兩月，鬚髮盡白。政和五年十二月，以龍圖閣直學士知熙州。前線將領有瀘州都巡檢使種友直，山西將家子，沉密能任事，捕得生猱並以繩梯攀崖；思黔州巡檢田祐恭，本思黔土丁，出身藥箭手，輕捷習山險；同統制王育、馬覺、張思正，分別由樂共城路、長寧軍路、梅嶺堡水蘆氈中路進兵。瀘州知州賈宗諒是這場亂局的起因：他是武人，喜生事，科斂夷部竹木，又誣大首領斗箇旁等之罪而杖脊黥配，致諸族反噬；出戰失利，裨將陳世基、王士傑死於陣，後被除名為民、編置河外。樂共城兵馬監押潘虎詐降殺首，被趙遹列出斬於市。叛方盟主卜漏居晏州多岡部眾之首，曾謀出戎瀘、直據成都，北屯劍門，東守白帝，並欲與吐蕃、谿洞修婚姻以為唇齒；政和六年七月與沅州黃安俊、定邊軍李吪移並伏誅，函首中庫。
peopleEn: Zhao Yi, transport commissioner of the Zizhou circuit, directed the campaign. He was touring Chanzhou when the alarm reached him, rode to Luzhou, and with Jia Ruoshui settled the first question of all: what would stop the enemy, riding on their momentum, from crossing the Lu river and driving north? He therefore pressed Jia Zongliang to occupy Jiang'an with his troops, blocking the enemy's thrust from the water and drawing grain for the army from the nearby stockades; he then memorialised the throne on the fault of the governor of Luzhou in provoking the rising, asked to conduct the pacification himself, and once the fighting was joined petitioned for troops from Shaanxi. He discovered that one face of the great stockade of Lunshou was sheer cliff and thinly held; he went over the ground in plain clothes on horseback, and settled on the plan of firing the place. In the eleventh month he carried the stockade and took Bu Lou; he opened up more than two thousand li of country, raised stockades, settled cultivators upon the land, and trained the people to fight and to garrison themselves by the rule of the northwestern archer associations; the two months of the expedition turned his hair white. In the twelfth month of that same year he was made Scholar of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion and governor of Xizhou. The field officers were Zhong Youzhi, patrol commander of Luzhou, a soldier's son out of Shanxi, taciturn and reliable, who caught the monkeys and rigged the rope ladders; Tian Yougong, patrol commander of Siqian, a native of the Siqhou levies, a poison-arrow man by birth, quick-footed and at home among the mountains; and the commanders Wang Yu, Ma Jue and Zhang Sizhen, who came in by the Yuegong city road, the Changning army road and the middle road through Meiling fort and Shuiluanqian respectively. Jia Zongliang, governor of Luzhou, was the origin of the whole affair: a soldier by temperament, fond of making trouble, he levied bamboo and timber from the native districts and then, on a charge he had manufactured, had the great chief Dou Jianpang and others flogged, branded and exiled, and the tribes took it as a killing. He fought and was beaten, and his commanders Chen Shiji and Wang Shijie were killed; later he was stripped of rank, made a commoner and exiled beyond the frontier. Pan Hu, the mounted commander at Yuegong, took chiefs in under a flag of submission and killed them, and Zhao Yi laid the business open, whereupon he was beheaded in the market. The confederation was headed by Bu Lou, chief of the Duogang people of Yanzhou, who had planned to go out through Rong and Lu, to sit straight in Chengdu, to hold Jianmen in the north and Baidi in the east, and to bind the Tibetans and the cave peoples to himself by marriage so that they would be lips and teeth to each other. In the seventh month of the following year he was executed together with Huang Anjun of Yuanzhou and Li Xiyi of Dingbian, and their heads were sent to the imperial storehouse.
kits: 此役的弩，是全場最能說明攻守兩面的一種兵器。叛方最倚重它：趙遹行狀記夷中山谷深險，林箐沮洳，賊上下捷倍飛走，尤善用弩，以藥傅矢，中人血濡縷輒死；在這樣的溪谷密林之間，短弓不便施展，弩的單發力道與穿林精度便占了上風，卜漏據輪縛大囤時，又居高臨下以矢石直瞰官軍，中者即齏粉。官軍則恰好在同一處吃了弩的短處：弩與強弓的彈道平直，守軍以強弓弩仰射，曾不能及半。大囤山崛起數百仞、周四十餘里，兵陳四周凡累日，箭矢只能落到半途，官軍只能日夕迭攻以耗其力。弩的長處在城寨與隘口，短處在平直的彈道：它在城牆上比長弓可靠，野地裡卻比長弓脆弱。攻方最後靠的不是投射兵器，而是工程與火。種友直、田祐恭連夜入箐探路，緣藤葛上絕壁，捕得生猱，長編記數十、通鑑記數千，以麻絞成長炬、灌以膏蠟，令猱負之；入夜先以數輩登崖巔，繫繩梯數十縋下，眾銜枚攀梯而上，及柵乃燃炬縱猱，賊廬舍皆茅竹所構，火輒發，猱驚火熾，官軍鼓噪破柵，諸軍以雲梯同時進攻，遂一舉登城。器械方面，寨防用巨石為城壘、外設木柵，通路鑿坑、置拒馬、布溝渠；糧秣賴人夫挑擔與就近諸壘轉輸，最後在輪縛大囤所得孳生糧斛甚眾。宋軍出師名冊中保甲弓手、土丁子弟正是這支遠射兵力的主體，弩在這個體系裡擔任的，正是城寨防禦與隘口截擊。
kitsEn: The crossbow is the one weapon of this campaign that displays both faces of the business at once. The insurgents relied on it most: the record of Zhao Yi's service says that in these districts the valleys are deep and the woods and marshes thick, the rebels move up and down the slopes like birds and beasts, and are especially skilled with the crossbow, coating their arrows with poison so that a man whose blood was touched by them died within two days. In ravines and closed timber like this the short bow is awkward to use, and the single heavy shot and the accuracy of the crossbow through the trees won the day; when Bu Lou held the stockade of Lunshou he shot arrows and stones down from above onto the troops below, and a man struck was cut to pieces. The Song army suffered from precisely the other side of the same weapon: the bolt of the crossbow and of the strong bow flies flat, and the besiegers found that their strong bows and crossbows shooting upward could not even reach half way. The mountain of Lunshou rose several hundred zhang and measured more than forty li around; the army ringed it for days on end, the arrows fell short by half, and nothing remained but assault after assault to wear the defenders down. The strength of the crossbow lay in stockades and passes, its weakness in that flat trajectory: on a wall it is more reliable than the long bow, in the open field it is more fragile. What finally decided the assault was not the missile weapon but engineering and fire. Zhong Youzhi and Tian Yougong went into the thickets at night to reconnoitre, climbed by vine and creeper to the sheer cliff, and caught live monkeys, of which the chronicle of the Northern Hall counts tens and the Xu Zizhi Tongjian counts thousands; hemp was twisted into long torches soaked with grease and wax, and the monkeys were made to carry them. At nightfall a few men first climbed to the crest, let down dozens of rope ladders, and the rest went up the ladders with gags in their mouths; on reaching the fence they lit the torches and turned the monkeys loose, and since the rebels' huts were of bamboo, wood and thatch, the fire took wherever a monkey ran, and the panic and the burning grew together. The soldiers broke the fence, beat the drums and charged, and all columns went up on scaling ladders at once, and the place was carried. The works of the defence were of dressed stone with a timber palisade outside, pits dug across the roads, sharpened stakes and ditches on the approaches. Provisions were carried by porters and drawn from the nearby stockades, and the store of grain and beasts seized at the stockade of Lunshou was considerable. The Song order of battle names the bowmen of the baojia militia and the sons of the tribal levies as the shooting strength of the force, and in that system the crossbow did the work of defending stockades and of cutting off the passes.
tactics: 叛方的打法是典型的山地部族戰法：來則蜂集蟻聚，去則鳥飛獸散；不求一次攻下重鎮，先分兵四出，圍攻樂共城、長寧、武寧、江門、安遠、鎮溪等十餘座寨堡，攻不下便焚掠而去，專打守具不飭、聲援孤絕的空隙。上元燈夕奇襲梅嶺堡得手後，瀘南守備為之一空，官軍屯戍與烽燧一時無所依憑。官軍的戰術有三層。第一層是斷其外援：先據江安縣，據水當賊衝，以近邊諸壘轉餉；再以厚賞募人招誘、匿起朝廷的捕殺賞格，刺貓牲、雞血，和酒飲誓，使羅始黨首領失胃率五十餘村來降，官方推算如此可減西兵一萬人。第二層是恩威並施：樂共城收降後曾發生詐降殺首之事，宋廷聞訊反把潘虎斬於市籍以示不殺，並在詔書中明言脅從之人如能悔過自新即許招降。第三層是攻法：十月自江安分三路出師，王育由樂共城路、馬覺由長寧軍路、張思正由梅嶺堡與水蘆氈中路，會於晏州輪縛大囤；沿途思峨州最險固，浹旬乃破，張思正克水蘆氈斬級二百一十二，馬覺奪五里隘口斬卜漏之子得皆，攻梅嶺囤攻五日乃克。合圍之後，官軍晝夜迭攻，居次者又進，更迭率晝夜止，把守軍耗到疲頓；趙遹同時分兵修復梅嶺堡，創築板橋、梅嶺埧、卓望堡、三頭山、寧遠寨烽火臺，恢復被燒毀的沿邊寨堡，使深在夷腹的樂共、長寧重新有呼應之勢。最後一夜的破寨是全戰關鍵：攀崖、縋梯、燃炬、縱火、雲梯同時並用，兵分內外相應，一舉登城。
tacticsEn: The way the insurgents fought was the classic mountain warfare of the tribal communities: they massed like bees and ants when they came, and scattered like birds and beasts when they left; they did not try to take a great city in one stroke, but split into columns to surround more than a dozen stockades — Yuegong city, Changning, Wuning, Jiangmen, Anyuan, Zhenxi and the rest — and where a place would not fall they burned and plundered and withdrew, always striking at the gaps in a defence left without its works and without support. Their raid on Meiling fort on the night of the Lantern Festival succeeded because precisely such a gap existed, and southern Luzhou was left stripped of defence, with the government garrisons and beacon stations of the frontier suddenly without anything to rely on. The Song plan worked in three layers. The first was to cut the insurgents off from help: occupy Jiang'an first, block the enemy's thrust from the water and draw supplies from the nearby stockades; then raise the reward for those who would bring people in, conceal the court's standing price on heads, and have the chiefs swear the oath of the cat and the cock mingled with wine, until the Luo Shidang chief Shiwei came in with more than fifty villages, which the court reckoned would reduce the western army by ten thousand men. The second was to mix severity with leniency: after chiefs who had surrendered at Yuegong were murdered, the court's answer was to behead Pan Hu in the market and so publish that it did not kill, and the rescript said plainly that those who had been forced along and were willing to turn back should be pardoned and allowed to surrender. The third was the way of assault. In the tenth month the army set out from Jiang'an in three columns — Wang Yu by the Yuegong city road, Ma Jue by the Changning army road, Zhang Sizhen by the middle road through Meiling fort and Shuiluanqian — and closed upon the stockade of Lunshou in Yanzhou. On the way the great fortified place of Si'e took the best part of ten days; Zhang Sizhen took Shuiluanqian with two hundred and twelve heads taken, Ma Jue seized the pass of Wuli and cut down Bu Lou's son Dejie, and Meiling fell only after five days of assault. Once the ring was closed the army attacked by day and night in relays, the second rank taking the place of the first, until the defenders were worn out; at the same time Zhao Yi sent men to repair Meiling fort and to raise new works at Banqiao, Meilingba, Zhuowang, Santoushan and the beacon tower at Ningyuan, restoring the burnt-out frontier stockades so that Yuegong and Changning, standing deep in the tribal country, had something to answer to. The last night of the siege was the hinge of the whole campaign: climbing, the rope ladders, the torches, the fire and the scaling ladders were all used together, and the troops took the place from within and without at the same moment.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間：政和五年正月，卜漏反，攻陷梅嶺堡；三月官軍戰不利，裨將陳世基、王士傑為賊所害，官軍死者百數；四月轉為招安，晏州三縣三十五村並羅始黨一百三十五村先後來降；七月請調陝西兵，詔涇原三千、環慶二千、永興二千，限五日起發；十月初發兵江安；十一月上旬進抵輪縛大囤，攻數日不下；十一月中旬破囤擒卜漏；政和六年正月以瀘南獻捷，轉宰職一官，七月卜漏伏誅。兵力：叛方號稱十餘萬眾，九月朝廷判其不滿萬兵；晏州六縣強壯丁口不減萬人，羅始黨百三十餘村一旦響應即有二三萬人可為敵。官軍初集時與成都府路、利州、夔州路援師及賈宗諒所部合共萬餘；趙遹自陳今所用之兵多非五萬少非三萬，遂請秦鳳、涇原、環慶各遣二萬，朝廷實撥涇原三千、環慶二千、永興二千，另以秦鳳兵馬應副。出師時合陝西各路將兵與本路土軍、義軍、土丁子弟、保甲弓手、人夫，共三萬五百四十人；破囤後追捕卜漏的精甲步騎為五千；攻囤之夜攀崖的隊伍由種友直與田祐恭所部選得二千餘人。戰果：自入酋境至破晏州，斬馘七千餘級；自破晏州至獲卜漏，又斬馘一萬餘級，並築為京觀；破輪縛大囤一役記斬首三千一百，焚蕩屋舍數千間，獲孳生糧斛甚眾；思峨州攻浹旬乃破，水蘆氈斬級二百一十二，梅嶺囤斬首三百餘級。拓地：平州二、縣八，諸囤三十餘城，環二千餘里。輪縛大囤山崛起數百仞、周四十餘里。出師至還凡兩月。追查：賈宗諒除名為民、編置河外，潘虎斬於市，趙遹、賈若水、王良弼、楊彥章各貶秩二等。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. In time: Bu Lou rose in the first month of Zhenghe 5 and carried Meiling fort; in the third month the government troops lost a fight, Chen Shiji and Wang Shijie were killed by the insurgents and a hundred soldiers fell; in the fourth month the business turned to pacification, and thirty-five villages of three counties of Yanzhou together with a hundred and thirty-five villages of the Luo Shidang came in by degrees; in the seventh month the court dispatched the Shaanxi troops, three thousand from Jingyuan, two thousand from Huanqing and two thousand from Yongxing, to start within five days; the army set out from Jiang'an in the tenth; in the eleventh it reached the stockade of Lunshou and assaulted it for several days without success; in the middle of the eleventh month it carried the stockade and took Bu Lou; in the first month of the next year the victory of southern Luzhou was reported at court and the chancellor's rank was raised by one grade, and in the seventh month Bu Lou was executed. In strength: the insurgents claimed a following of more than a hundred thousand, but the court judged in the ninth month that their armed force numbered fewer than ten thousand; the able-bodied men of the six counties of Yanzhou were said not to fall below ten thousand, and the hundred and thirty-odd villages of the Luo Shidang, if they answered the call, could put two or three ten thousands into the field. The Song troops first gathered — the reinforcements from the Chengdu, Lizhou and Kuizhou circuits together with Jia Zongliang's own command — came to a little over ten thousand. Zhao Yi estimated that the force needed must be more than fifty thousand and less than thirty thousand, and asked for twenty thousand each from the Qinfeng, Jingyuan and Huanqing circuits; the court in fact sent three thousand from Jingyuan, two thousand from Huanqing and two thousand from Yongxing, with Qinfeng troops to follow. When the expedition set out it counted three thousand five hundred and forty men in all, the Shaanxi contingents joined with the local trained companies, volunteer levies, the sons of the tribal levies, the bowmen of the baojia militia and porters; five thousand armoured foot and horse were used to chase Bu Lou after the fall of the stockade; and the two thousand odd men who climbed the cliff on the night of the assault were drawn from the commands of Zhong Youzhi and Tian Yougong. In results: from the first entry into the tribal country to the fall of Yanzhou, more than seven thousand were killed or captured; from the fall of Yanzhou to the taking of Bu Lou, more than ten thousand, and their heads were piled in mounds; the assault on the stockade of Lunshou alone is recorded as three thousand one hundred heads taken, several thousand dwellings burned, and a large quantity of grain and beasts seized. The fortified place of Si'e took the best part of ten days, Shuiluanqian yielded two hundred and twelve heads, Meiling three hundred odd. In territory: two prefectures, eight counties and more than thirty stockades were taken and the frontier carried for more than two thousand li. The mountain of Lunshou rose several hundred zhang and measured more than forty li around. From the setting out of the army to its return was a matter of two months. As for the reckoning afterwards: Jia Zongliang was stripped of rank, made a commoner and exiled beyond the frontier, Pan Hu was beheaded in the market, and Zhao Yi, Jia Ruoshui, Wang Liangbi and Yang Yanzhang were each demoted by two grades.
cause: 起事直接由一件州官處置失當引起。瀘州南部晏州六縣水路十二村、思峨州洞與十州五村團的熟夷，自唐末以來與漢地州縣形成羈縻關係，耕田採藥、按寨自守，歷來被州官視為素黠勇善鬥的邊患。政和四年，瀘州知州賈宗諒以需用竹木為名科斂夷部，又誣大首領斗箇旁等之罪，杖其脊、黥配且死。按夷法，重罪不過償貲畜，漢地官府用刑逾格，等於公然殺死盟主，於是諸夷憤怒，聲言官殺其酋長非罪，跳呼礪兵甲，種類回應。卜漏趁勢主盟，提出的計畫相當大：盡結諸夷，出戎、瀘，直據成都，北屯劍門，東守白帝，內乘無備，外絕聲援，並與吐蕃、谿洞修婚姻之好以為唇齒。上元燈夕，他利用蜀地久安、人不習兵、寨堡守具不飭的空隙奇襲梅嶺堡得手，一時聲勢大盛，蜀土震動。朝廷最初的辦法是招撫而非討伐，趙遹四月駐樂共城，以厚賞募人招誘，得夷賊千餘人及首領斗岡等二百四十七人，晏州三縣三十五村並羅始黨諸族一百三十五村先後來降，卜漏與斗岡等亦刺貓牲雞血、和酒飲誓，歸順一時；然而宋廷在樂共城收降後發生詐降殺首之事，夷眾由此不復信官府，而朝廷不殺的詔令又不足以壓住各寨自保的決心，衝突重新拉開，最終由招撫轉為大舉討伐。九月朝廷判斷叛方背盟犯順，人神共棄，才正式下令進討。
causeEn: The rising began directly in one badly handled case of a prefectural official. The settled natives of the twelve river villages of Yanzhou's six counties, of the Si'e caves and of the five village-groups of the ten districts to the south had stood in a loose holding relationship with the Chinese prefectures and counties since the end of the Tang; they tilled fields, gathered herbs and garrisoned their own fastnesses, and the Chinese officials had long treated them as a frontier menace, quick and fierce in fight. In the fourth year of Zhenghe the governor of Luzhou, Jia Zongliang, levied bamboo and timber from the native districts in the name of his own needs, and then upon a charge he had manufactured had the great chief Dou Jianpang and others flogged and branded and exiled, some of them dying of it. By native custom a heavy offence should have been compounded for with animals and goods; a Chinese office punishing beyond its custom was tantamount to killing the chief of the alliance in public, and the tribes were furious, declaring that the office had killed their chief without cause, and calling for arms and swearing they would answer one another. Bu Lou used the grievance to become the head of a league, and the plan he set out was a large one: to bind all the tribes together, to go out through Rong and Lu, to sit straight in Chengdu, to hold Jianmen in the north and Baidi in the east, to take advantage of the emptiness within and cut off help from without, and to cement the alliance with the Tibetans and the cave peoples by marriage so that they would be lips and teeth to each other. On the night of the Lantern Festival he took advantage of a long peace in Shu, a population unused to arms and frontier works left in poor repair, surprised Meiling fort and carried it, and for a while the whole circuit shook. The court's first answer was pacification rather than war. Zhao Yi reached Yuegong in the fourth month and raised the reward for those who would bring people in; more than a thousand of the insurgents and two hundred and forty-seven of their chiefs, among them Dou Ge, were brought in, and thirty-five villages of three counties of Yanzhou together with a hundred and thirty-five villages of the Luo Shidang came in by degrees; Bu Lou and Dou Ge and the others even swore the oath of the cat and the cock with wine, professing a single heart to the Song. But after the chiefs who came in at Yuegong were killed, the tribes ceased to trust the office, and the court's word that it would not kill was not enough to break the determination of each fastness to hold its own. The quarrel reopened, and what had begun as an attempt to pacify turned by the ninth month into a full campaign, the court ruling that the insurgents had broken their oath and deserved the war now to be made against them.
impact: 此役的結果，是宋朝在西南邊疆第一次由守禦轉為設治。趙遹在平定之後並未止於掃平：所平州二、縣八、諸囤三十餘城，一律於要害處建置寨堡，拓地環二千餘里，劃其疆畝，募並邊之人耕種，使民習戰守，方法比照西北弓箭社之制，編為勝兵。同年十二月朝廷以平晏夷曲赦四川，並於瀘南置沿邊安撫司，以孫羲叟知瀘州充安撫使，把晏州正式納入沿邊鎮守體系。在朝政層面，這是一場以將帥論功的戰役：賈宗諒除名編置、潘虎斬市、趙遹等貶秩，而趙遹隨即升為龍圖閣直學士、知熙州，凸顯朝廷對威不足以服邊、恩不足以結人心的檢討。制度上，這次平亂確立了西南招討使、沿邊安撫司、寨堡與弓箭社式民兵的一套做法，成為後來南宋經營川西南與廣西溪洞的樣板。放到整個北宋的戰略裡，晏州之戰另有深一層意義：政和五年正是女真完顏阿骨打建國稱帝之年，西南邊患剛剛平定，朝廷的注意力與兵力卻迅速轉向東北，十年間遼亡金興，靖康之難隨之而來。這場發生在川南山區、規模不大的平叛，是宋金易代前夜西南邊境最後一次大規模用兵，也提醒後人：北宋真正的國運開支不在西南而在幽雲。史稱自此十有二年不敢北向窺邊，朝廷得以無南顧之憂——這句總結語既是實錄，也是西南邊防代價的結算。
impactEn: The outcome of this campaign was the first time the Song turned from defence to administration on the south-western frontier. When the fighting was over Zhao Yi did not stop at sweeping the country clear: of the two prefectures, eight counties and more than thirty stockades taken, works were raised at the points that mattered, the frontier was carried for more than two thousand li, the fields were surveyed and laid out, settlers were enrolled to cultivate them, and the people were trained to fight and to garrison themselves by the rule of the northwestern archer associations, organised as a body of victorious soldiers. In the twelfth month of that same year the court remitted the sentences throughout Sichuan in honour of the pacification of Yanzhou, established an Office of Pacification for the Southern Luzhou Frontier, and appointed Sun Xisou governor of Luzhou as pacification commissioner, bringing Yanzhou formally into the system of frontier command. At the level of government this was a war fought to make examples. Jia Zongliang was stripped of his rank and exiled, Pan Hu was beheaded, Zhao Yi and his colleagues were demoted, and Zhao Yi was then made Scholar of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion and sent to Xizhou: the court was saying in effect that severity alone could not hold a frontier and kindness alone could not bind hearts. Institutionally the settlement fixed a set of practices for the south-west — a commander of pacification, a frontier pacification office, frontier stockades and archer-association militia — which served as the model for how the Southern Song would later govern south-western Sichuan and the cave country of Guangxi. Placed in the wider strategy of the Northern Song, the campaign has a further meaning. The fifth year of Zhenghe was the very year in which the Jurchen Wanyan Aguda proclaimed himself emperor; the south-western trouble had just been settled, yet the court's attention and its soldiers turned swiftly to the north-east, and within ten years the Liao fell, the Jin rose, and the disaster of Jingkang followed. This small war in the mountains of south-western Sichuan was the last large use of force on that frontier before the change of dynasty, and it is a reminder that the real drain on the Song was not in the south-west but in the region of You and Yun. The chroniclers' summary — that for twelve years they did not venture north to look across the frontier, and the court had no further worry to the south — is both a true record and the settlement of the bill for the south-western frontier.
result: 十一月，輪縛大囤破，卜漏擐重甲突圍，走至山後輪多囤被生擒，諸酋長同被捕獲，各路降者相繼而至，諸囤悉平。趙遹的記載更細：自入酋境至破晏州，斬馘七千餘級；自破晏州至獲卜漏，又斬馘一萬餘級，並築為京觀；所平州二、縣八、諸囤三十餘城，拓地環二千餘里；脅從者准其就俘與歸，所獲老弱亦悉放還，不留為質。出師到還凡兩月，趙遹鬚髮盡白。官方的處置隨之展開：政和五年十二月，以平晏夷曲赦四川，置瀘南沿邊安撫司，以孫羲叟知瀘州充安撫使，並以趙遹為龍圖閣直學士、知熙州；政和六年正月以瀘南獻捷，宰相轉一官；同年七月，卜漏與沅州黃安俊、定邊軍李吪移一併伏誅，首級函送中庫。晏州一帶從此改由寨堡與弓箭社式民兵防守，新附之地劃田募耕，邊境大定。這場戰爭留下的東西比一場平叛更多：一是西南邊防從羈縻到設治的一整套做法——招討統制、沿邊安撫司、寨堡、弓箭社；二是對招撫的經驗教訓——詐降殺降一次，就把招撫的路堵死，逼出一次三萬五千人的大舉討伐；三是兵器層面的實證：弩在山林與城寨中是可靠的中短程兵器，卻因平直彈道而無法仰攻數百仞高山，最終破寨靠的是繩梯、雲梯與火，而不是更多的箭。這條教訓在此後的西南攻寨戰役裡一再被重複。
resultEn: In the eleventh month the stockade of Lunshou fell, Bu Lou broke out in heavy armour and was taken alive with the other chiefs at the stockade of Luntuo behind the mountain; those who surrendered came in party after party, and the stockades were all taken. Zhao Yi's own account is more exact: from the first entry into the tribal country to the fall of Yanzhou, more than seven thousand were killed or captured; from the fall of Yanzhou to the taking of Bu Lou, more than ten thousand, and their heads were piled in mounds; two prefectures, eight counties and more than thirty stockades were taken and the frontier carried for more than two thousand li; those who had been forced along were allowed to surrender and return, and the old and weak who had been seized were set free rather than held as hostages. From the setting out of the army to its return took two months, and Zhao Yi's hair turned white. The official reckoning followed. In the twelfth month of that year the sentences throughout Sichuan were remitted in honour of the pacification of Yanzhou, the Office of Pacification for the Southern Luzhou Frontier was established with Sun Xisou as governor of Luzhou and pacification commissioner, and Zhao Yi was made Scholar of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion and governor of Xizhou; in the first month of the next year the victory of southern Luzhou was reported at court and the chancellor's rank was raised by one grade; and in the seventh month of that year Bu Lou was executed together with Huang Anjun of Yuanzhou and Li Xiyi of Dingbian, and their heads were sent to the imperial storehouse. From then on the country about Yanzhou was defended by stockades and by archer-association militia, the newly attached land was parcelled out and settled, and the frontier was quiet. What the war left behind was more than a rebellion put down. First, a whole method for the south-western frontier, moving from a loose holding relationship to actual administration: a commander of pacification, a frontier pacification office, stockades and archer-association militia. Second, hard experience of pacification itself — a single false surrender followed by murder closed the road of pacification and forced the great expedition of thirty-five thousand men. Third, a plain demonstration in arms: the crossbow was a reliable weapon of short and middle range in woodland and behind stockades, yet because its bolt flies flat it could not be used to assault a mountain of several hundred zhang, and the place was finally carried by rope ladders, scaling ladders and fire, and not by more arrows. That lesson was repeated in every later assault on a south-western stockade.
